extracted.summary: A solicitor asks for £28,500 to fund a client's financial remedy case at the Family Court in Cardiff, where the only asset is a flat with about £25,000 equity.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To review it we would need the date of the next hearing or listing, confirmation of your client's details and the current stage of proceedings, and supporting evidence of the flat's value and the outstanding mortgage or charges. A summary of the other liabilities and any expected costs budget to final hearing would also help. Once we have those we will come back to you with an update; nothing in this email should be taken as any indication of whether funding can be offered or on what terms.
